title: EN–Marathi notice pair
promptText:
Produce a matched English + Marathi pair of a short official public notice for MahaTransco / district administration.

Input brief (facts only):
[Paste bullets: what / where / when / why / action for citizens / official update channel]

Deliver:
1. English notice (90–140 words) — formal public notice style
2. Marathi notice (same meaning, natural official Marathi, not literal translation)
3. Side-by-side checklist confirming both versions share identical facts
4. Term consistency table: EN term | MR term (8–10 rows)

Rules:
- Do not add new facts.
- Keep names of places and times identical across languages.
- If a fact is missing, insert [VERIFY] in both versions.
- Avoid Sanskritised over-formal Marathi that citizens cannot parse; prefer clear administrative Marathi.
- End both versions with: updates only via official channels.
